# GMEOW Accessibility Module

The GMEOW Accessibility Module — classes, properties, and individuals of the GMEOW super-vocabulary.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/accessibility>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:slices/accessibility`  

**Type:** `owl:Ontology`  

Cross-cutting accessibility layer — whether an entity can reach or use a location under constraints (wheelchair/step-free, sensory, clearance, life-support). Accessibility features, barriers, and needs are modelled as orthogonal, co-equal value facets (Principle 9). The flat shortcuts (hasAccessibilityFeature, hasBarrier, hasAccessibilityNeed) cover the 80 % case; promote to AccessibilityAssertion when provenance, confidence, temporal scope, or suppression matter (Principle 10). Accessible routes are computed by the solver layer, not asserted in OWL (Principle 12). Part of the #42 Location-as-reference-frame epic.

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/accessibility>
